rules.title: Limit multiple-outlet branch-circuit load to circuit ampere rating
rules.intent: Prevent overload of branch circuits that supply two or more outlets or receptacles by restricting permissible loads according to circuit size.
evidence_required: Panel schedule showing branch-circuit ratings and connected loads
Branch-circuit load calculations per outlet
One-line diagram identifying multiple-outlet circuits

rules.title: Restrict 15- and 20-ampere branch-circuit loads to permitted lighting and utilization equipment
rules.intent: Ensure general-purpose 15- and 20-ampere circuits supply only lighting and utilization equipment within the load subdivisions of 210.23(A)(1) and (A)(2).
evidence_required: Panel schedule identifying 15- and 20-ampere multioutlet circuits
Fixture and equipment schedules with connected VA per circuit
Identification of dedicated small-appliance, laundry, and bathroom circuits

rules.title: Limit cord-and-plug equipment not fastened in place to 80 percent of circuit rating
rules.intent: Prevent a single portable cord-and-plug-connected appliance from monopolizing or overloading a shared 15- or 20-ampere branch circuit.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate ratings
Branch-circuit rating on panel schedule
Load calculation showing 80 percent check for cord-and-plug equipment

rules.title: Restrict 30-ampere branch-circuit loads
rules.intent: Limit 30-ampere multioutlet circuits to heavy-duty lampholder lighting in non-dwelling occupancies or utilization equipment, with an 80 percent cap on any one cord-and-plug load.
evidence_required: Panel schedule identifying 30-ampere circuits and served loads
Lampholder type (heavy-duty) documentation for fixed lighting
Equipment nameplate ratings versus 80 percent of circuit rating

rules.title: Restrict 40- and 50-ampere branch-circuit loads
rules.intent: Limit 40- and 50-ampere multioutlet circuits to fixed cooking appliances in any occupancy, and to fixed heavy-duty-lampholder lighting, infrared heating, or other utilization equipment only outside dwelling units.
evidence_required: Panel schedule identifying 40/50-ampere circuits and served equipment
Appliance schedule showing cooking appliances fastened in place
Occupancy classification on plans

rules.title: Install receptacle outlets where required by 210.52 through 210.65
rules.intent: Establish the general obligation to provide receptacle outlets, including outlets for flexible-cord connections and appliance receptacles within reach of the appliance location.
evidence_required: Floor plans with receptacle outlet locations
Appliance layout showing receptacle within 6 ft of each specific appliance
Electrical legend distinguishing receptacle outlet types

rules.title: Mount required receptacle outlets at least 12 inches above the floor [DPH]
rules.intent: California DPH amendment: keep required 15-, 20-, and 30-ampere receptacle outlets accessible by mounting their centers not less than 12 inches above the floor or working platform.
evidence_required: Interior elevations or mounting-height notes for receptacles
Floor plans identifying required 210.52(A), (B), (C) receptacles
Details for baseboard heater or floor outlet installations claimed under exceptions

rules.title: Provide required dwelling unit 125-volt, 15- and 20-ampere receptacle outlets
rules.intent: Scope rule: dwelling unit receptacle outlet requirements apply to 125-volt, 15- and 20-ampere receptacles, and required receptacles are in addition to certain non-countable receptacles.
evidence_required: Dwelling unit floor plans with all receptacle outlets shown
Receptacle schedule distinguishing required versus non-countable receptacles
Baseboard heater product data where heater receptacles are counted

rules.title: Install general-provision receptacle outlets in habitable rooms
rules.intent: Guarantee receptacle availability in every habitable room and similar area of a dwelling unit per the spacing, wall space, floor receptacle, and countertop-exclusion provisions.
evidence_required: Floor plans with wall-space receptacle layout dimensions
Room schedule identifying habitable rooms
Notes excluding countertop receptacles from wall-space count

rules.title: Space wall receptacles so no point is more than 6 feet from an outlet
rules.intent: Eliminate the need for extension cords by keeping every point along the floor line of wall space within 6 feet of a receptacle outlet.
evidence_required: Dimensioned floor plans showing receptacle spacing along walls
Wall-space takeoff including fixed panels and room dividers
Receptacle symbols legend

rules.title: Serve kitchen countertop receptacles from at least two small-appliance circuits with no other outlets
rules.intent: Preserve dedicated 20-ampere small-appliance branch-circuit capacity for kitchen and dining area receptacle loads.
evidence_required: Panel schedule showing two or more 20-ampere small-appliance circuits
Kitchen power plan with circuit numbers at countertop receptacles
Circuit directory confirming no other outlets on small-appliance circuits

rules.title: Serve all kitchen and dining area receptacle outlets from the small-appliance circuits
rules.intent: Route all wall, floor, countertop, and refrigeration receptacle outlets in kitchen and dining areas through the required 20-ampere small-appliance branch circuits.
evidence_required: Circuit directory mapping kitchen/dining receptacles to small-appliance circuits
Refrigeration receptacle circuiting on power plan
Individual branch-circuit identification for dedicated appliances

rules.title: Provide receptacle outlets for countertops and work surfaces 12 inches or wider
rules.intent: Ensure countertop and work-surface appliance loads in kitchens and similar areas have dedicated, properly located receptacle outlets.
evidence_required: Kitchen elevations/plans with countertop dimensions and receptacle locations
Multioutlet assembly product data and length takeoff where used
Receptacle count reconciliation against wall-space requirements

rules.title: Space countertop wall receptacles at maximum 24 inches from any point
rules.intent: Keep every point along the countertop wall line within cord reach of a receptacle outlet.
evidence_required: Dimensioned countertop plans with receptacle spacing
Location of ranges, cooking units, and sinks relative to counter wall line
Figure 210.52(C)(1) exemption geometry check where claimed

rules.title: Provide island and peninsular countertop receptacles by surface area
rules.intent: Size the receptacle count for island and peninsular countertops/work surfaces by area and locate at least one outlet near the peninsular outer end.
evidence_required: Island/peninsula countertop area calculations
Plan locations of island/peninsular receptacles
Countertop-mounted receptacle assembly listings where used

rules.title: Provide a bathroom receptacle within 3 feet of each basin
rules.intent: Ensure grooming-appliance receptacles are within reach of each bathroom basin and properly located relative to the basin and countertop.
evidence_required: Bathroom plans/elevations with receptacle-to-basin dimensions
Countertop receptacle assembly listing where installed in countertop
Panel schedule showing 20-ampere bathroom branch circuit

rules.title: Install outdoor receptacle outlets per 210.52(E)(1) through (E)(3)
rules.intent: Scope rule: outdoor receptacle outlets at dwellings must satisfy the one/two-family, multifamily, and balcony/deck/porch provisions.
evidence_required: Site/exterior elevation plans showing outdoor receptacle locations
Dwelling type identification (one-family, two-family, multifamily)
Mounting heights above grade or walking surface

rules.title: Provide front and back outdoor receptacles at one- and two-family dwellings
rules.intent: Guarantee grade-accessible outdoor receptacles at both the front and back of each one-family dwelling and each grade-level two-family dwelling unit.
evidence_required: Exterior elevations showing front and back receptacle locations and heights
Site plan confirming grade accessibility
GFCI protection device identification per 210.8(A)(3)

rules.title: Provide a receptacle at balconies, decks, and porches
rules.intent: Ensure dwelling balconies, decks, and porches adjacent to the unit have an accessible receptacle outlet at usable height.
evidence_required: Plans showing balcony/deck/porch receptacle locations
Detail showing horizontal proximity of balcony/deck/porch to dwelling
Mounting height above walking surface

rules.title: Provide a receptacle in each garage vehicle bay
rules.intent: Ensure each vehicle bay of attached garages and powered detached garages has its own receptacle outlet at accessible height.
evidence_required: Garage plan showing receptacles per vehicle bay with mounting heights
Panel schedule showing 20-ampere garage branch circuit per 210.11(C)(4)
Identification of attached versus detached garage and power supply

rules.title: Provide a receptacle in hallways 10 feet or longer
rules.intent: Ensure long dwelling hallways have at least one receptacle outlet for cleaning and portable equipment.
evidence_required: Floor plan with hallway centerline length dimension
Hallway receptacle location on power plan

rules.title: Install required lighting outlets with wall-mounted control
rules.intent: Ensure habitable rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, stairways, garages, outdoor entrances, guest rooms, and storage/equipment spaces have required, properly controlled lighting outlets; outlet boxes complying with 314.27(E) may serve as these lighting outlets.
evidence_required: Lighting plans showing outlet and control device locations per room
Switching/control schedule (wall controls, occupancy sensors, overrides)
Stairway riser count and control locations at each level
Listing documentation for wall-mounted control devices

rules.title: Include 150 VA per 2 feet of lighting track in load calculations
rules.intent: Ensure feeder and service load calculations account for lighting track capacity in non-dwelling occupancies.
evidence_required: Feeder/service load calculation including track lighting VA
Reflected ceiling plan with track lengths
Current-limiting device rating documentation where exception used

rules.title: Protect flexible cords and fixture wires per 240.5
rules.intent: Ensure flexible cords, flexible cables, and fixture wires on branch circuits have overcurrent protection appropriate to their ampacity as required by 240.5.
evidence_required: Branch-circuit overcurrent device ratings on panel schedule
Cord and fixture wire sizes/types on fixture schedules
Tap and cord protection notes referencing 240.5

rules.title: Install luminaire-supporting outlet boxes as required by 314.23
rules.intent: Ensure outlet boxes and fittings that support luminaires are themselves supported and installed per the box support rules of 314.23.
evidence_required: Box support/mounting details on drawings
Box listing and installation instructions
Ceiling framing attachment details

rules.title: Use outlet boxes complying with 314.27 for luminaire and fan support
rules.intent: Ensure boxes supporting luminaires or ceiling-suspended (paddle) fans meet the applicable box provisions of 314.27, including fan-rated boxes and locking support and mounting receptacle systems.
evidence_required: Box listing labels (fan-rated / luminaire weight rating)
Fixture and fan mounting details
Locking support and mounting receptacle product listing where used

rules.title: Install multioutlet assemblies per 380.10
rules.intent: Scope rule: where multioutlet assemblies are used to satisfy countertop receptacle requirements, their installation is governed by 380.10 (referenced from 210.52(C)(3)); the source text in this community contains only the cross-reference, so this rule captures the trigger for that subtree.
evidence_required: Multioutlet assembly product data and listing
Plan/elevation showing assembly length and receptacle spacing
Receptacle-outlet count calculation using 12 in. per outlet

rules.title: Mount receptacles in countertops and work surfaces per 406.5
rules.intent: Scope rule: receptacle mounting in countertops and work surfaces is governed by 406.5(E), (F), and (G); the source text in this community contains only the cross-reference, so this rule captures the trigger for that subtree.
evidence_required: Countertop/work-surface receptacle assembly product listings
Installation details referencing 406.5(E), (F), (G)

rules.title: Use listed countertop receptacle outlet assemblies in countertops
rules.intent: Permit receptacles in countertops only where the receptacle outlet assembly is listed for use in countertops.
evidence_required: Listing label/product data for countertop receptacle assembly
Plan location of countertop-installed receptacles
Manufacturer installation instructions

rules.title: Use listed work-surface receptacle outlet assemblies in work surfaces
rules.intent: Permit receptacles in work surfaces only where the receptacle outlet assembly is listed for use in work surfaces, per the 406.5(F) cross-reference in 210.52(C)(3).
evidence_required: Listing label/product data for work-surface receptacle assembly
Plan location of work-surface-installed receptacles

rules.title: Comply with 406.5(G) for receptacles in countertops and work surfaces
rules.intent: Scope rule: 406.5(G) governs installation of receptacles in both countertops and work surfaces (referenced from 210.52(C)(3) and 210.52(D)); the source text in this community contains only the cross-reference.
evidence_required: Installation details for countertop/work-surface receptacles
Product listing documentation

rules.title: Keep suspended luminaires, track, pendants, and paddle fans out of the bathtub/shower zone
rules.intent: Prevent shock hazard by excluding cord-, chain-, or cable-suspended luminaires, lighting track, pendants, and ceiling-suspended (paddle) fans from the zone around bathtubs and showers, and by requiring damp/wet-location marking within the zone.
evidence_required: Bathroom reflected ceiling plan with zone dimensions from tub rim/shower threshold
Luminaire schedule with damp/wet location markings
Fixture cut sheets showing suspension type

rules.title: Install lighting track permanently, within its rating, and outside prohibited locations
rules.intent: Ensure lighting track is permanently installed and connected, loaded within its rating, supplied by a branch circuit not exceeding the track rating, and kept out of prohibited locations.
evidence_required: Track rating and branch-circuit rating comparison on panel schedule
Reflected ceiling plan showing track locations and mounting heights
Track and fitting listing documentation
Connected fixture load tabulation per track run

rules.title: Support luminaires by compliant outlet boxes or fittings
rules.intent: Ensure luminaires supported by outlet boxes use boxes installed per 314.23 that comply with 314.27, and recognize 314.27(E) boxes as required lighting outlets.
evidence_required: Box mounting and support details
Box listing showing luminaire support rating
Lighting plan cross-referencing required lighting outlets

rules.title: Meet cord-connection conditions for lampholders and luminaires
rules.intent: Ensure cord-connected lampholders and electric-discharge/LED luminaires are protected against cord damage and connected only under the permitted conditions.
evidence_required: Fixture cut sheets showing cord connection method and plug type
Field condition photos or details showing cord routing and visibility
Branch-circuit rating versus luminaire full-load current calculation

rules.title: Support ceiling-suspended (paddle) fans by listed means
rules.intent: Prevent falling fans by requiring support independent of an outlet box or by listed fan-rated boxes/box systems per 314.27(C) or listed locking support and mounting receptacle systems per 314.27(E).
evidence_required: Fan-rated box listing labels or independent support details
Fan mounting installation instructions
Locking support and mounting receptacle listing where used

rules.title: Use listed locking support and mounting receptacles within their ratings
rules.intent: Allow appliances to be supported and connected by separable attachment fittings only where the locking support and mounting receptacle is listed, compatible, used within its ratings, and installed per 314.27(E).
evidence_required: Listing documentation for locking support and mounting receptacle
Appliance and fitting compatibility/rating data
Installation detail referencing 314.27(E)

rules.title: Wire strip lights and connector strips with 125 degree C insulated conductors at 60 degree C ampacity
rules.intent: Protect stage strip-light and connector-strip wiring from heat degradation by mandating high-temperature insulation while limiting ampacity to 60 degree C values.
evidence_required: Conductor type and insulation temperature rating on wiring schedules
Ampacity calculation using 60 degree C column
Connector strip shop drawings showing drop wire type and length

rules.title: Construct portable strips like border lights and protect their supply cables
rules.intent: Ensure portable strip lights meet border-light construction requirements and that supply cables are bushed and strain-relieved.
evidence_required: Portable strip construction/shop drawings or listing data
Bushing and strain-relief details at cable entries
Cable type documentation (extra-hard usage where required)

rules.title: Use listed extra-hard usage cords for portable stage equipment
rules.intent: Ensure flexible conductors supplying portable stage equipment are rated for the abuse of stage environments, with limited hard-usage allowances only under protected, 20-ampere-or-less conditions.
evidence_required: Cord/cable listing and usage designation (extra-hard vs hard usage)
Branch-circuit overcurrent device ratings for portable equipment circuits
Cord routing/support details for protected applications
Ampacity determination per 400.5 or Table 520.44(C)(2)
